page.打开 PecoFence，桌面上的图标会自动分好类。: Start PecoFence and your desktop icons are sorted for you.
page.打开 PecoFence，从开始菜单或桌面快捷方式打开都行。: Start PecoFence from the Start menu or a desktop shortcut.
page.第一次打开时，它会在屏幕右边建好三个栅栏，把桌面图标按类型放进去。没分到类的图标: The first time, it creates three fences on the right side of the screen and puts your desktop icons into them by type. Icons that fit none of them stay where they were, as on the Windows desktop. They belong to the “Desktop” fence, which shows no title or edges.
page.以后桌面上有了新文件，也会自动放进对应的栅栏。: New files that show up on the desktop later go into the matching fence automatically.
page.想恢复原样，就右键托盘图标（任务栏右下角的 PecoFence 图标，没看到就先: To get your old desktop back, right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar; if you don't see it, select ^ first) and select Exit PecoFence. Your files stay in your Desktop folder the whole time. PecoFence only shows them in fences.
page.分类按的是整理规则，右键托盘图标选「设置…」，在「整理规则」页就能改。规则都对不: Sorting rules decide which fence each icon goes to. To change them, right-click the tray icon, select “Settings…” and open the “Sorting rules” page. Files that match no rule go to the “Desktop” fence.
page.第一次打开时，右下角会依次显示几条小技巧，点<b>「下一条」</b>往下看，点: The first time you open it, a few tips show one after another at the bottom right: Next shows the next one, × closes them. Later, when a feature would help, for example when you have many fences or keep opening the same folder, a tip points it out once. To stop them, turn off “Feature tips” on the General page of the settings.
page.想把一类图标单独放在一起，就给它们新建一个栅栏。: Want to keep a group of icons together? Give them a fence of their own.
page.在桌面空白处按住鼠标，拖出一个框。框不要碰到已有的栅栏和图标。: Press and hold on an empty part of the desktop and drag out a box. Don't let the box touch an existing fence or icon.
page.松开鼠标，点框右下角的<b>「新建栅栏」</b>。: Release the mouse button and click New fence at the box's bottom-right corner.
page.新栅栏的标题会自己变成输入框，直接输入名字，再按 <kbd>Enter</kbd: The title of the new fence turns into a text box by itself. Type a name and press <kbd>Enter</kbd>.
page.把图标拖进新栅栏。: Drag icons into the new fence.
page.也可以右键某个栅栏的标题栏，在「添加到桌面」里选「新建栅栏」，新栅栏会放在它旁边: You can also right-click a fence's title bar and select “New fence” under “Add to desktop”. The new fence goes into a free spot next to it. The tray menu has “New fence” too.
page.以后想改名，就右键栅栏的标题栏，选「重命名…」。: To rename a fence later, right-click its title bar and select “Rename”.
page.栅栏想放哪就拖到哪，大小也能随时改。靠近别的栅栏时会自动对齐。: Drag a fence wherever you like and resize it anytime. It lines up with other fences when you bring it close.
page.按住标题栏拖动，栅栏就跟着走。靠近别的栅栏或屏幕边缘时会自动对齐；和同一行、同一: Drag the title bar and the fence follows. Near another fence or the edge of the screen it snaps into line, and when its edge is a few pixels off another fence in the same row or column, it lines up however far apart they are. A guide shows which edges line up. Don't drop it on another fence's title bar, or the two fences merge into tabs.
page.把鼠标移到栅栏边缘，光标变成双箭头后拖动，就能改大小。这条边也会自动对齐，经过正: Point to the edge of a fence. When the pointer turns into a double arrow, drag to resize. The edge snaps into line too, and it stops for a moment at the height that shows every icon.
page.拖动任意一个角，宽和高一起改，图标会自动重新排列。: Drag a corner to change the width and height together. The icons rearrange themselves.
page.双击栅栏的下边框，或者右键标题栏选「适应内容大小」，高度就正好放下全部图标。拖动: Double-click the bottom edge of a fence, or right-click its title bar and select “Fit to content”, and its height fits every icon. Hold <kbd>Alt</kbd> while dragging to turn off snapping. To keep a fence from being moved by accident, right-click its title bar and select “Lock position and size”. A locked fence shows a lock icon in its title bar while the pointer is over it.
page.暂时用不到的栅栏可以收起来，只留标题栏。鼠标停一下，它就展开。: Roll up a fence you don't need right now, so only its title bar is left. Rest the pointer on it and it expands.
page.双击标题栏，栅栏就收起来，只剩标题栏，上面会显示里面有几项。: Double-click the title bar. The fence rolls up to just its title bar, which shows how many items are inside.
page.鼠标在收起的标题栏上停一下，它会自动展开；移开就又收起来。刚收起时鼠标还在标题栏: Rest the pointer on a rolled-up title bar and the fence expands. Move away and it rolls up again. If the pointer is still on the title bar right after you roll the fence up, move it away and back first.
page.想让它一直展开，点标题栏右边的箭头，或者再双击一次标题栏。: To keep it open, click the arrow at the right end of the title bar, or double-click the title bar again.
page.不想鼠标一停就展开，可以在「设置」→「常规」→「收起与展开」里把「收起的栅栏怎么: If you'd rather it didn't expand on hover, go to “Settings” → “General” → “Roll up and expand” and set “How rolled-up fences expand” to “On a title click”. A fence then expands only when you click its title bar, and the next click rolls it up again. With “On hover” (the default) or “On a title click”, dragging a file over a rolled-up title bar also expands it, so you can drop the file in. With “Only on double-click or the arrow”, only a double-click on the title bar or a click on the arrow expands it.
page.展开得太快或太慢，可以在它下面的「展开快慢」里选「快」或「慢」。: If it expands too fast or too slowly, choose “Fast” or “Slow” under “Expand speed” just below.
page.把想要的效果告诉 AI 助手，它会用 PecoFence 自带的命令行工具 pe: Tell an AI agent what you want, and it makes the changes with pecofence-cli, the command-line tool that comes with PecoFence.
page.打开 PecoFence，再打开你的 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、C: Start PecoFence, then open your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex and Cursor all work) and send it your request.
page.按这段话，助手会先运行 <code>pecofence-cli skill</c: Following this request, the agent first runs pecofence-cli skill and pecofence-cli describe to learn how the tool works. Then it checks your current configuration and backs it up before changing anything.
page.接着它运行命令修改配置。每改一项，桌面上的栅栏马上跟着变。: Next it runs commands to change the configuration. Your fences update on the desktop with each change.
page.先阅读 pecofence-cli skill 和 pecofence-cli: First read pecofence-cli skill and pecofence-cli describe. Check and back up my configuration, then switch the theme style to Liquid Glass and make all fences more transparent.
page.Microsoft Store 版装好就能直接用 <code>pecofence: With the Microsoft Store edition, pecofence-cli works right after installation. With the installer or portable edition, give the agent the full path to pecofence-cli.exe: the installer puts it in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\PecoFence by default, and the portable edition keeps it in the folder you extracted.
page.把图标拖进另一个栅栏，它就显示在那里。在普通栅栏之间拖来拖去，文件本身不动。: Drag an icon into another fence and it shows up there. Between regular fences, the file itself stays where it is.
page.按住图标，拖进另一个栅栏再松开。目标栅栏会亮起来，并提示「移动到 工作」。要是提: Drag an icon into another fence and release it. The target fence lights up and says “Move to Work”. If the hint names a folder instead, the file really moves into that folder when you release it.
page.想一次移好几个，先按住 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> 逐个点选，或者在栅栏空白: To move several icons at once, hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> and click each one, or drag a box around them in an empty part of the fence. Then drag them together.
page.拖到桌面空白处松开，图标就离开栅栏，留在桌面上，停在松开的那一格。: Drop an icon on an empty part of the desktop and it leaves its fence and stays on the desktop, in the cell where you let it go.
page.不想拖，也可以右键图标，在「移动到栅栏」里选一个栅栏。: Rather not drag? Right-click the icon and pick a fence under “Move to fence”.
page.0.3.2 以前装的 PecoFence，「桌面」还是一个带标题的栅栏，拖到桌面: If you installed PecoFence before version 0.3.2, “Desktop” is still a fence with a title, and an icon dropped on an empty part of the desktop goes back into that fence.
page.每个栅栏都可以单独设置图标大小、排列顺序和显示方式。: Each fence has its own icon size, sort order and view.
page.鼠标放在栅栏里，按住 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> 滚动滚轮，图标就会变大或变: With the pointer over a fence, hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> and turn the mouse wheel. The icons get bigger or smaller, and the fence's height adjusts; fences below it move out of the way. This works only in the “Icons” view, and not on a fence with “Lock position and size” on.
page.右键标题栏，在<b>「排序方式」</b>里选一种，比如<b>「按类型」</b>。: Right-click the title bar and pick an order under Sort by, such as Type. The icons slide to their new places.
page.在<b>「视图」</b>里可以换成<b>「列表」</b>或<b>「详细信息」</: Under View, you can switch to List or Details. Details shows the date modified, type and size.
page.「视图」菜单里也能直接选图标大小。排序方式是「手动」时，新出现的图标排在最后，和: You can also pick an icon size from the “View” menu. With the “Manual” sort order, new icons go to the end, as on the Windows desktop; an icon dragged in from another fence lands where you drop it between two icons, and a line shows the place while you drag. In Details view, click a column header to sort by that column, and click it again to reverse the order.
page.加一条规则，以后新文件就会自动放进你指定的栅栏。: Add a rule and new files go straight to the fence you choose.
page.打开「设置」→「整理规则」（右键托盘图标，选<b>「设置…」</b>），展开<b: Open “Settings” → “Sorting rules” (right-click the tray icon and select Settings…), then expand New rule. Enter “Invoice” as the “Rule name”, set “Condition type” to Name contains, and enter “Invoice” as the “Condition value” too.
page.「目标栅栏」选「报销」（这里只列出已有的栅栏），点<b>「添加规则」</b>。新: Set “Target fence” to “Expenses” (only existing fences are listed) and select Add rule. The new rule goes to the top of the list. Rules are checked from the top down and the first one that matches wins, so invoices go to “Expenses”, and the “Files and documents” rule below never gets them.
page.以后桌面上出现名字带「发票」的文件，就会自动进「报销」。: From now on, any new file on the desktop with “Invoice” in its name goes straight to “Expenses”.
page.桌面上原有的图标不会自己挪。点<b>「立即应用」</b>，桌面上的图标都会按规则: Icons already on the desktop don't move on their own. Select Apply now and every icon on the desktop is sorted by the rules, also ones you dragged out of a fence; icons you put into a fence yourself stay put. Not what you wanted? Select Undo in the notice that appears, and everything goes back.
page.托盘菜单里的「立即应用整理规则」效果一样。想一步建好栅栏和规则，可以用「快速添加: “Apply sorting rules now” in the tray menu does the same. To create a fence and its rule in one go, use the buttons under “Quick add”. “Add condition” gives a rule another condition; only items that match all of them go to the target fence. The “Edit” button on the right of a rule changes it, and “Move up” and “Move down” change the order.
page.更快的办法：右键一个文件，选<b>「以后把 .pdf 文件都放到这里」</b>（: Quicker: right-click a file and choose “Put all .pdf files here from now on” (the menu shows that file's extension). From then on, files of that type go into this fence by themselves.
page.没放进栅栏的图标，和 Windows 桌面上的一样，想放哪就拖到哪。: Icons that are in no fence behave like icons on the Windows desktop: drag one anywhere and it stays there.
page.没放进栅栏的图标排在屏幕左上角，没有标题也没有边框。按住一个，拖到桌面空白处。: Icons that are in no fence stand at the top-left corner of the screen, with no title and no border. Press one and drag it to an empty place on the desktop.
page.松开鼠标，图标就停在这一格，重启以后也不变。再拖一个，放在它旁边。: Release the mouse button and the icon stays in that cell, also after a restart. Drag another one and put it beside the first.
page.以后桌面上出现的新文件，如果没有被整理规则放进栅栏，就放进从左上角数起的第一个空: From now on, a new file on the desktop that no sorting rule puts into a fence takes the first free cell, counted from the top-left corner.
page.右键其中一个图标，菜单里的<b>「自由摆放」</b>前面有个勾。点一下关掉，图标: Right-click one of these icons: Place freely has a tick in the menu. Click it to turn it off and the icons line up in order at the top left. Click it again and they return to where you put them.
page.这些图标属于「桌面」栅栏。新装的 PecoFence 会把它<b>「像桌面一样排: These icons belong to the Desktop fence. A new installation of PecoFence turns on Arrange like the desktop and Place freely for it. If you installed PecoFence before version 0.3.2, Desktop is still an ordinary fence with a title: right-click its title bar, click “Arrange like the desktop”, then “Place freely”.
page.一次拖几个图标，它们会保持彼此的位置。把栅栏挪到图标上面，被盖住的图标会让到最近: Icons that you drag together keep their places relative to each other. When you move a fence over icons, the covered icons move to the nearest free cells.
page.这两个开关也在「设置」→「栅栏」里，选「桌面」就能看到。关掉「像桌面一样排列」，: Both switches are also in “Settings” → “Fences” once you select “Desktop”. Turn off “Arrange like the desktop” and Desktop is an ordinary fence again that you can move and resize.
page.几个栅栏可以合成一个，像浏览器的标签页一样来回切换。: Combine several fences into one and switch between them like browser tabs.
page.按住一个栅栏的标题栏，拖到另一个栅栏的标题栏上，那条标题栏会亮起来。: Drag a fence by its title bar onto another fence's title bar. That title bar lights up.
page.松开鼠标，两个栅栏就合成了一个。拖过来的那个变成新标签页，并且直接显示出来。: Release the mouse button and the two fences become one. The fence you dragged becomes a new tab and opens right away.
page.点标签就能切换。点过这个栅栏以后，也可以按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<k: Click a tab to switch to it. Once you've clicked in the fence, you can also press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd>.
page.想拆开，就按住标签往下拖。拖出标题栏后，它又变回单独的栅栏，拖到桌面空白处松开就: To split them up again, drag a tab down. Once it leaves the title bar, it's a separate fence again. Drop it on an empty part of the desktop.
page.把图标拖到某个标签上，它就直接放进那一页。右键标题栏或标签，「标签页」里也有「合: Drop an icon on a tab to put it straight into that tab. Right-click the title bar or a tab to find “Merge into” and “Detach into its own fence” under “Tabs”.
page.想看看壁纸，或者截一张干净的桌面，双击一下桌面空白处就行。: Want to see your wallpaper or take a clean screenshot? Just double-click an empty part of the desktop.
page.在桌面空白处双击，栅栏就都藏起来了。: Double-click an empty part of the desktop and all your fences disappear.
page.设了<b>「双击桌面隐藏时保留此栅栏」</b>的栅栏会留在桌面上，比如这里的「常: Fences with Stay visible when fences are hidden turned on stay on the desktop, like “Favorites” here. This switch is in Fence options… on the fence's menu.
page.再双击一次，栅栏就回来了。: Double-click again and the fences come back.
page.也可以右键托盘图标（任务栏右下角的 PecoFence 图标），选<b>「隐藏所: You can also right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar) and select Hide all fences.
page.隐藏以后，托盘菜单里这一项会变成「显示所有栅栏」。不想双击桌面时隐藏，可以在「设: While fences are hidden, this tray menu item reads “Show all fences”. If you don't want a double-click to hide fences, turn off “Double-click the desktop to hide or show fences” in “Settings” → “General”.
page.窗口挡住桌面时，按一下快捷键，栅栏就浮到最上面，不用把窗口最小化。: When windows cover the desktop, press a shortcut to bring your fences to the front. No need to minimize anything.
page.按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>空格: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd>. All fences float above your windows and everything else dims.
page.看完了，再按一次快捷键，或者点一下栅栏外面的地方，栅栏就回到窗口下面。还没点过栅: When you're done, press the shortcut again or click outside the fences, and they go back behind the windows. If you haven't clicked a fence yet, <kbd>Esc</kbd> works too.
page.速览时可以直接双击图标打开文件。文件打开后，速览会自动结束，切到别的窗口也一样。: While peeking, double-click an icon to open the file. Peek ends once the file opens, and also when you switch to another window.
page.也可以右键托盘图标（任务栏右下角的 PecoFence 图标），选「速览所有栅栏: You can also right-click the tray icon (the PecoFence icon at the right end of the taskbar) and select “Peek at all fences”. To change the shortcut, use the Keyboard shortcut list in “Settings” → “Peek and search”. With Press Ctrl twice chosen, tapping Ctrl twice quickly starts Peek, and the key combination no longer works. For a combination that isn't in the list, choose Custom… and press it.
page.速览时直接打字，就能按名字找图标和文件，下一节细讲。: While peeking, just type to find icons and files by name. The next lesson shows how.
page.速览时直接打字，就能按名字找到栅栏里的图标。打开 Everything 以后，整: While peeking, just type to find the icons in your fences by name. With Everything turned on, you find files on the whole computer too.
page.速览时直接打字，搜索框就会出现。在「设置」→「速览与搜索」把<b>「快捷键」</: While peeking, just start typing and the search box appears. Once you set Keyboard shortcut to Press Ctrl twice in “Settings” → “Peek and search”, you can tap Ctrl twice quickly at any time to open Peek with the search box, and twice again to close it.
page.输入名字里的几个字，框下面就列出找到的图标和它所在的栅栏，栅栏里的这个图标也会亮: Type a few letters of a name. The list under the box shows the matching icons and the fence each one is in, and the icon lights up in its fence. Chinese names also match by pinyin, in full or by initials: hyjl finds 会议记录 (meeting notes).
page.在「设置」→「速览与搜索」里打开<b>「速览搜索也找整台电脑（Everythin: Turn on Peek search also finds files on the whole computer (Everything) in “Settings” → “Peek and search”, and the list also shows files found on the whole computer. Everything is a free file search tool, and Install Everything under the switch sets it up for you.
page.按 <kbd>↓</kbd> 或 <kbd>↑</kbd> 选一行，按 <kbd: Press <kbd>↓</kbd> or <kbd>↑</kbd> to pick a row and <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open it, which also ends Peek. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd> to <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>9</kbd> open the matching row directly; the selected row shows its key. The bar at the bottom of the list shows the common keys and how many results there are.
page.想只看一种文件，点搜索框下面的类型，比如「文件夹」或「图片」，也可以按 <kbd: To see only one kind of file, click a type under the search box, such as “Folders” or “Images”, or press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> for the next one.
page.按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> 打开所在的: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> opens the containing folder. Right-click a row, or press <kbd>→</kbd> with the cursor at the end of what you typed, to choose Open, Open containing folder, Copy path, or the Windows context menu.
page.从搜索里打开得越多的项目，下次排得越靠前。这份记录留在这台电脑上，导出的配置里没: What you open from the search most often comes first next time. That history stays on this PC and is not part of exported configurations. Finding files on the whole computer by pinyin needs Everything 1.5, which is the version “Install Everything” installs.
page.在桌面显示文件夹: Show a folder on the desktop
page.把常用的文件夹放到桌面上，变成一个文件夹栅栏。文件夹里有什么，它就显示什么。: Put a folder you use a lot on the desktop as a folder fence. It shows whatever is in the folder.
page.右键栅栏里的文件夹图标，选<b>「在桌面显示此文件夹」</b>。: Right-click a folder icon in a fence and select Show this folder on the desktop.
page.旁边会多出一个栅栏，里面就是这个文件夹的内容。标题前有个小文件夹图标，表示这是文: A new fence appears next to it with the folder's contents. The small folder icon before the title marks it as a folder fence.
page.双击子文件夹，就在栅栏里打开它。点标题最左边的向上箭头、按 <kbd>Backs: Double-click a subfolder to open it inside the fence. To go back up a level, click the up arrow at the far left of the title bar, press <kbd>Backspace</kbd> or press the mouse's back button. The mouse's forward button takes you back into the subfolder you just left.
page.把文件拖进来，文件就真的移进了这个文件夹。在普通栅栏之间拖来拖去不会挪动文件，这: Drag a file in and it really moves into the folder. That's the difference from regular fences, where dragging never moves the file.
page.托盘菜单里的「在桌面显示文件夹」可以直接选文档、下载、图片等文件夹。把文件从这里: “Show a folder on the desktop” in the tray menu lets you pick Documents, Downloads, Pictures and other folders directly. Dragging a file from a folder fence to a regular fence or the desktop moves the file to the desktop. When you no longer need the fence, right-click its title bar and select “Delete fence”. The folder and its files stay where they are.
page.在最上层的文件夹里，单击标题前的小文件夹图标，就用资源管理器打开这个文件夹。: At the folder's top level, click the small folder icon before the title to open the folder in File Explorer.
page.也可以在桌面空白处拖出一个框，松开后点框右下角的<b>「在此显示文件夹…」</b: You can also drag a box on an empty part of the desktop and click “Show a folder here…” at its bottom-right corner when you release: the folder fence goes where the box was.
page.文件夹里的东西多时，在栅栏里按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>F</: When a folder holds a lot, press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>F</kbd> in the fence, or right-click the title bar and select “Filter…”: the title bar turns into a search box, and as you type only the files whose names match stay, pinyin initials too; the box shows how many there are. <kbd>Enter</kbd> closes the box and leaves a tag at the right of the title bar; its × or <kbd>Esc</kbd> shows everything again.
page.先输入一个类型名：扩展名（比如 pdf），或者文件夹、文档、图片、视频、音乐、压: First type a type name: an extension such as pdf, or folders, documents, images, videos, music, archives or programs. When the box shows a hint such as “Type: PDF  Tab” at the right, press <kbd>Tab</kbd>: it becomes a tag, the fence shows only files of that type, and you can go on typing to filter names. Typing kind:pdf followed by a space does the same. <kbd>Backspace</kbd> in an empty box removes the tag.
page.只想看最近下载的文件？在托盘菜单，或者栅栏右键菜单的「添加到桌面」里，选<b>「: Only want to see what you downloaded lately? Pick New smart fence… in the tray menu, or under “Add to desktop” in the fence right-click menu, and a small window opens: a click on a template such as “Downloads of the last 7 days” or “Screenshots of the last week” fills in the conditions, or add your own row by row; below, it shows at once how many files they find. Click “Create” and the fence shows only the files that match, new files appear by themselves, and the files stay in their folder. A folder with a magnifier sits before the title, and the number of files in a small capsule at the right of the title bar. To change the conditions, right-click the fence and choose “Edit conditions…”.
page.普通栅栏里双击文件夹，默认用资源管理器打开。想让它也在栅栏里打开，右键标题栏选「: In a regular fence, double-clicking a folder opens it in File Explorer. To open it inside the fence instead, right-click the title bar, select “Fence options…” and turn on Open folders and folder shortcuts inside this fence. Click the up arrow, press Backspace or press the mouse's back button to bring back the fence's own icons.
page.智能栅栏里放的是一条保存下来的搜索，比如最近 7 天下载的文件。符合条件的文件会: A smart fence holds a saved search, such as the files downloaded in the last 7 days. Files that match show up in it by themselves, and the files stay where they are.
page.右键任意一个栅栏的标题栏，在<b>「添加到桌面」</b>里选<b>「新建智能栅栏: Right-click the title bar of any fence and choose New smart fence… under Add to desktop. The tray menu has it too.
page.在打开的小窗口里点一个模板，比如<b>「最近 7 天下载」</b>，名称和条件就: In the small window that opens, click a template such as Downloads of the last 7 days. The name and the conditions are filled in, and the line below says at once how many files they find. You can also add conditions of your own, row by row.
page.点<b>「创建」</b>，桌面上多出一个栅栏，里面是符合条件的文件，最新的排在前: Click Create. A new fence appears on the desktop with the files that match, newest first. A folder with a magnifier sits before its title, and the small capsule at the right of the title bar shows the number of files.
page.以后有新文件符合条件，它会自己出现在这里。文件一直在原来的文件夹里，栅栏只是把它: From now on, a new file that matches shows up here by itself. The files stay in their own folder; the fence only lists them.
There are five templates: Downloads of the last 7 days, Screenshots of the last week, Files over 1 GB, All .psd files and Recently opened files. To change the conditions, right-click the fence and choose Edit conditions….
page.只搜一个文件夹的智能栅栏不需要别的软件。要搜整台电脑，需要免费的文件搜索工具 E: A smart fence that searches one folder needs no other software. Searching the whole computer needs Everything, a free file search tool; if it is not installed, right-click the fence to install it.
page.智能栅栏里的文件可以打开、拖出去、重命名和删除，但不能往里拖文件。删除智能栅栏不: You can open, drag out, rename and delete the files in a smart fence, but you cannot drag files into it. Deleting a smart fence leaves every file alone. Press <kbd>F5</kbd> to search again right away.
page.速览搜索列表最后一行的「把这次搜索放到桌面」，也会把这次搜索变成一个智能栅栏。: The last row of the Peek search list, “Put this search on the desktop”, also turns that search into a smart fence.
page.用 Windows 的虚拟桌面把工作和娱乐分开时，栅栏也能分开：让一个栅栏只在你: If you use Windows virtual desktops to keep work and play apart, your fences can follow: a fence can show only on the desktop you choose.
page.右键栅栏的标题栏，在<b>「在哪个虚拟桌面显示」</b>里选一个桌面。这里列出的: Right-click a fence's title bar and pick a desktop under Show on virtual desktop. The list shows the desktops of Windows Task View, here “Work” and “Games”.
page.这个栅栏就从当前桌面消失了。右下角的通知会说明它去了哪个桌面。: The fence leaves the current desktop. A notification in the bottom-right corner says which desktop it went to.
page.按 <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>→<: Press <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>→</kbd> to switch to that desktop: the fence is there. The small icon before its title means that it shows on this desktop only. Fences that belong to another desktop are not here; fences with no desktop of their own are on every desktop.
page.还没有第二个虚拟桌面的话，按 <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</: No second virtual desktop yet? Press <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> to open Task View and click “New desktop”. With only one virtual desktop the menu has no “Show on virtual desktop” item.
page.想让以后新建的栅栏都只属于当时所在的桌面，到「设置」→「常规」打开<b>「每个虚: To have every new fence belong to the desktop you make it on, turn on Separate fences for each virtual desktop in “Settings” → “General”.
page.想让栅栏回到每个桌面，在同一个菜单里选<b>「所有虚拟桌面」</b>。鼠标停在标: To put a fence back on every desktop, choose All virtual desktops in the same menu. Point at the small icon before the title to see which desktop the fence belongs to.
page.没放进其他栅栏的图标（「桌面」栅栏）在每个桌面都显示，新文件会落在这里。: Icons that are in no other fence (the Desktop fence) show on every desktop, and new files land there.
page.可以给所有栅栏换一种风格，也可以给某个栅栏单独换颜色、调透明度。: Change the style of all fences at once, or give one fence its own color and transparency.
page.在「设置」→「常规」→「主题风格」里选 Fluent 或 Liquid Glas: In “Settings” → “General” → “Theme style”, choose Fluent or Liquid Glass. All fences change right away.
page.想单独调一个栅栏，右键它的标题栏，选<b>「栅栏选项…」</b>。: Right-click a fence's title bar and select Fence options… to adjust just that fence.
page.在<b>「色调」</b>里点一种颜色，玻璃就染上这个颜色。打开<b>「只给标题栏: Under Tint, click a color to tint the glass. Turn on Tint the title bar only to color just the title bar.
page.把<b>「标题字号」</b>调大一些。<b>「不透明度」</b>选<b>「全透明: Make the Title text size a bit larger. Set Opacity to Fully transparent, and only the icons and title show, with the tint hidden too. The glass appears when you point to the fence.
page.「标题颜色」可以选白色、黑色或跟随色调。想用深色模式，在「常规」页改「颜色模式」: “Title color” can be white, black or match the tint. For dark mode, change “Color mode” on the “General” page. To tune the glass, colors and fonts yourself, choose “Custom · theme file” under “Theme style”; “How to write one” explains the theme file.
page.嫌标题栏占地方，可以让它平时藏起来，鼠标移上去再出来。: If title bars take up too much room, hide them until you point to a fence.
page.在「设置」→「常规」里往下翻到「标题栏与标签页」，打开<b>「鼠标悬停时才显示标: In “Settings” → “General”, scroll down to “Title bar and tabs” and turn on Show title bar only on hover. The title bars disappear and only the icons are left.
page.鼠标移到栅栏上，标题栏就出来了，图标位置不变。移开又藏起来。: Point to a fence and its title bar comes back, while the icons stay in place. Move away and it hides again.
page.想单独设置某个栅栏，就到「栅栏」页选中它，把<b>「显示标题栏」</b>改成<b: To set this for one fence, select it on the “Fences” page and change Show title bar to Always or On hover.
page.右键标题栏，选「栅栏选项…」，可以直接打开这个栅栏的设置。栅栏收起时只剩标题栏，: Right-click a title bar and select “Fence options…” to go straight to that fence's settings. A rolled-up fence is only a title bar, so its title bar always stays visible.
page.先存一份快照，栅栏拖乱了也能一键恢复。: Save a snapshot first, and you can undo a messed-up layout in one click.
page.右键托盘图标，选<b>「设置…」</b>，打开<b>「布局与备份」</b>。: Right-click the tray icon, select Settings… and open Layout and backups.
page.给快照起个名字（也可以不填），点<b>「保存快照」</b>。: Give the snapshot a name (optional) and select Save snapshot.
page.之后栅栏怎么挪都没关系。: Now move your fences around as much as you like.
page.点快照右边的<b>「恢复」</b>，栅栏的位置、大小和里面的图标都会回到保存时的: Select Restore next to the snapshot. The fences' positions, sizes and icons go back to how they were when you saved it. A “Before snapshot restore” entry also appears in the list, in case you change your mind.
page.快照只管栅栏布局。设置和整理规则可以用「导出…」存成文件，换电脑时再「导入…」。: Snapshots cover only the fence layout. To save your settings and sorting rules to a file, use “Export…”, then “Import…” on your new PC. PecoFence also backs up your full configuration every day and keeps the last 7. Restoring a backup replaces your settings and rules as well.
page.拖错了栅栏、改错了大小、把图标拖进了别的栅栏，或者删错了栅栏，点一下栅栏的标题再: Dragged a fence to the wrong place, resized it by mistake, dragged an icon into the wrong fence or deleted the wrong fence? Click a fence's title and press Ctrl+Z to undo it. The same goes for what you do to files in a fence: a rename, a delete, a file dragged into a folder, a paste or a new file. Each Ctrl+Z undoes the latest step. Files deleted for good with Shift+Delete cannot be brought back. After you delete a fence from its menu, a card with Undo also appears in the bottom-right corner, and a “Before fence delete” snapshot is saved automatically.
page.栅栏拖错了地方、图标放错了栅栏、栅栏删错了，按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+: Dragged a fence to the wrong place, put an icon in the wrong fence or deleted the wrong fence? Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> to take it back.
page.栅栏拖到了不想放的地方，按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kb: A fence ended up where you did not want it? Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> and it goes back. A fence you have just dragged already has the keyboard, so there is no need to click it first.
page.图标拖进了别的栅栏，也是按 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kb: An icon dragged into another fence comes back the same way: press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> and it returns to its fence and its place.
page.右键标题栏，选<b>「删除栅栏」</b>。栅栏里有图标时会先问一句，点<b>「是: Right-click the title bar and choose Delete fence. A fence that holds icons asks first. After Yes the fence is gone and its icons are back on the desktop.
page.右下角出现「已删除栅栏“工作”」的卡片。点<b>「撤销」</b>，或者在任意一个: A card “Fence “Work” deleted” appears in the bottom-right corner. Click Undo, or press Ctrl+Z on any fence, and the fence comes back with its icons.
page.每按一次 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd>，退回最近的一: Each <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> takes back the latest step, up to 20 steps. Click a fence first: its title bar, its edge or inside it.
page.在栅栏里改错了文件名、把文件删进了回收站、新建了文件夹、把文件拖进了文件夹，也都: A wrong file name, a file deleted to the Recycle Bin, a new folder or a file dragged into a folder can be undone too. A file deleted for good with <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Delete</kbd> cannot be brought back; PecoFence then says “A permanent delete cannot be undone.”
page.在「设置」→「整理规则」里点「立即应用」以后，右下角也会出现带「撤销」的卡片。: After “Apply now” in “Settings” → “Sorting rules”, a card with “Undo” appears in the bottom-right corner as well.
page.退出 PecoFence、导入配置、恢复备份或快照以后，之前的步骤就不能撤销了。: After you quit PecoFence, import a configuration or restore a backup or a snapshot, earlier steps can no longer be undone. For a longer way back, save a layout snapshot first.
page.小工具也放在栅栏里：便签用来记事和列待办，时钟显示时间和日期，脚本栅栏把脚本打印: Tools live in fences too: a note holds notes and to-dos, a clock shows the time and date, and a script fence shows the text a script prints on the desktop, such as the weather.
page.打开「设置」→<b>「小工具」</b>（右键托盘图标，选<b>「设置…」</b>: Open “Settings” → “Tools” (right-click the tray icon and choose “Settings…”) and click “New note” on the right of “Notes and to-dos”. A note appears on the desktop: just type, and press Enter for a new line.
page.点别处就保存了。行首写 <code>[ ]</code> 的一行会变成待办，点前: Click anywhere else to save. A line that starts with [ ] becomes a to-do: click its box to tick it, and click again to untick it. To change the note later, click its text.
page.点「时钟」右边的<b>「添加」</b>，桌面上多出一个时钟，显示时间、日期和星期: Click “Add” on the right of “Clock”, and a clock with the time, date and weekday appears on the desktop. The desktop holds one clock, so the button then turns grey and reads “On the desktop”. To see the seconds, right-click the clock and choose “Show seconds”.
page.点「天气」右边的<b>「添加」</b>，桌面上多出一个脚本栅栏。它定时运行一个小: Click “Add” on the right of “Weather”, and a script fence appears on the desktop. It runs a small script on a schedule and shows the text the script prints. This example shows the weather in Tokyo.
page.小工具和普通栅栏一样，可以拖动、改大小和收起。托盘菜单里，还有栅栏右键菜单的「添: Tools move, resize and roll up like any other fence. The tray menu, and “Add to desktop” in the fence right-click menu, also have “New note”. The clock, the weather and the other tools are under “New tool” right below it.
page.字太小看不清时，把时钟拖大一点，时间和日期就跟着变大。便签和脚本栅栏也能放大文字: Text too small to read? Drag the clock bigger, and its time and date grow with it. Notes and script fences can show bigger text too: right-click, choose “Fence options…” and pick “Large” or “Extra large” under “Text size”.
page.想看别的城市，右键「天气」栅栏，选<b>「编辑脚本」</b>，在记事本里把 To: For another city, right-click the “Weather” fence, choose “Edit script”, change Tokyo to your city in Notepad and save, then choose “Run now”. Under “Run interval” you choose how often it runs, from 1 minute to 3 hours. To use a script of your own, see “Write your own script fence”.
page.最上面的<b>「小工具」</b>开关关上以后，桌面上的小工具都不显示，脚本也全部: When you turn off the “Tools” switch at the top, every tool on the desktop is hidden and all scripts stop. Turn it on again, and they come back where they were. PecoFence itself never goes online for script fences. When an imported configuration has script fences, the “Tools” switch is turned off first, and you turn it back on once you trust the scripts.
page.脚本栅栏里能点的行: Clickable rows in a script fence
page.脚本打印的一行可以变成链接或按钮：点一下就打开网页或文件、运行程序、复制文字，或: A line a script prints can become a link or a button: one click opens a web page or a file, runs a program, copies text, or runs the script again right away.
page.这两个栅栏是「设置」→「小工具」里的<b>「GitHub 仓库动态」</b>和<: These two fences are “GitHub repository activity” and “PC status” in “Settings” → “Tools”: click “Add” on their right. Move the pointer onto a row you can click: the row gets a light background and the pointer becomes a hand. A row that opens a web page or a file also shows a small arrow on the right. Rest there a moment, and a tooltip appears.
page.点一下，浏览器打开这个 PR。这个栅栏列出一个 GitHub 仓库最新的 iss: Click, and the browser opens this pull request. This fence lists the newest issues and pull requests of a GitHub repository.
page.点最下面的<b>「刷新」</b>，脚本马上再运行一次。栅栏底部先显示正在运行，再: Click “Refresh” at the bottom, and the script runs again right away. The bottom line of the fence first says it is running, then shows the new update time.
page.「电脑状态」一直在运行，每 2 秒更新一次 CPU、内存和每个磁盘的剩余空间。点: “PC status” keeps running and updates the CPU, memory and free space on each drive every 2 seconds. Click the “IP address” row, and the address is copied: “Copied” shows next to the pointer, ready to paste.
page.点<b>「打开任务管理器」</b>，任务管理器就打开了。: Click “Open Task Manager”, and Task Manager opens.
page.想让自己的脚本也这样，在打印的一行后面加一条竖线，再写上参数，比如 <code>: To make your own script do this, add a vertical bar and parameters after a line it prints, for example Home page | href=https://example.com. For all the parameters, see “Write your own script fence”.
page.想看示例是怎么写的，右键栅栏，选<b>「编辑脚本」</b>，脚本会在记事本里打开: To see how an example is written, right-click its fence and choose “Edit script”: the script opens in Notepad. In the GitHub repository activity script, just replace the repository name with the one you follow.
page.脚本栅栏会运行你的脚本，把脚本打印的每一行显示在栅栏里。会一点 PowerShe: A script fence runs your script and shows each line the script prints. A little PowerShell or Python is enough to write one. If you don't write code, an AI assistant can write it for you.
page.打开「设置」→「小工具」，在<b>「用自己的脚本」</b>这一行点<b>「选择脚: Open “Settings” → “Tools”, click “Choose script…” in the “Your own script” row and pick a script file. A script fence appears on the desktop and runs the script once right away. “New tool” → “Your own script…” in the tray menu does the same.
page.也可以从示例改起。先添加「天气」这样的示例，再右键它的栅栏，选<b>「编辑脚本」: You can also start from an example. Add one such as “Weather”, then right-click its fence and choose “Edit script”. The script opens in Notepad. Change it and save it, then choose “Run now”.

page.不会。整理规则只决定图标显示在哪个栅栏，文件一直在桌面文件夹里。会动到真实文件的: No. Sorting rules only decide which fence shows an icon. The files stay in your Desktop folder. page.每个虚拟桌面能用不同的栅栏吗？: Can each virtual desktop have its own fences?
page.可以。右键栅栏标题，在<b>「在哪个虚拟桌面显示」</b>里选一个桌面，这个栅栏: Yes. Right-click a fence's title and pick a desktop under Show on virtual desktop: the fence then shows on that desktop only, with a small Task View icon before its title that tells which desktop when you point at it. When you switch virtual desktops, the fences that don't belong to the new one fade out. To have every new fence belong to the desktop you make it on, turn on Separate fences for each virtual desktop in “Settings” → “General”. The Desktop fence shows on every desktop, since new files land there.
page.桌面图标全不见了怎么办？: What if all my desktop icons are gone?
page.PecoFence 运行时会隐藏 Windows 自己的桌面图标，图标都显示在栅: While PecoFence is running, it hides the regular Windows desktop icons and shows them in fences instead. If they don't come back after you exit, right-click the desktop and select View → Show desktop icons. With Keep Windows desktop icons hidden when PecoFence closes on, do the same after uninstalling the Microsoft Store edition or deleting the portable edition. While PecoFence is running, you can also right-click the tray icon and select Fix missing desktop icons.
page.退出或卸载以后，桌面会变成什么样？: What happens to my desktop when I exit or uninstall?
page.退出后栅栏消失，桌面图标重新显示出来，和用 PecoFence 之前一样。如果在: When you exit, the fences go away and your desktop icons come back, just as before you used PecoFence. If Keep Windows desktop icons hidden when PecoFence closes is on in “Settings” → “General”, the icons stay hidden after you exit. Uninstalling the installer edition shows them again; the Microsoft Store and portable editions don't, so turn the switch off and exit before you uninstall or delete them. Uninstalling removes only the app itself; the files on your desktop aren't touched. The installer edition keeps your settings after uninstalling, while the Microsoft Store edition removes them too, so export your configuration first if you need it. The portable edition has no uninstaller: turn off Start with Windows in “Settings” → “General”, exit, and then delete the folder.
page.按 <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd> 时，栅栏会消失吗？: Do fences disappear when I press <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd>?
page.不会，栅栏默认会留在桌面上。想让它们跟着一起隐藏，到「设置」→「常规」，把<b>: No, by default fences stay on the desktop. To hide them as well, go to “Settings” → “General” and set When using Show desktop (Win+D) to Hide fences.
page.笔记本接上或拔掉外接显示器，栅栏还是那一套，只是摆放的位置不同。每换一种显示器组: When you plug in or unplug an external display on a laptop, you keep the same fences; only their positions change. PecoFence remembers a separate arrangement for each combination of displays, resolution and scaling, so everything is back in place when you return to it. The first time you use a new combination, the fences on each display start where they were at the same resolution and scaling before. When the screen gets smaller (for example at 150 % scaling) and a fence no longer fits, it moves to free space and gets shorter if needed; the extra icons scroll, and fences never end up on top of each other. To swap the fences between two displays, go to “Settings” → “Layout and backups” and select Swap.
page.新文件为什么进了「桌面」栅栏？: Why did a new file go to the “Desktop” fence?
page.新文件出现在桌面上时，PecoFence 会按整理规则给它找栅栏，一条都对不上就: When a new file appears on the desktop, PecoFence uses your sorting rules to find it a fence. If no rule matches, it goes to the “Desktop” fence. Add a rule in “Settings” → “Sorting rules” and similar files go to another fence from then on. You can also drag the icon into the fence you want; the rules won't move it again.
page.桌面上的图标能随意摆放吗？: Can I place desktop icons wherever I like?
page.能。没放进其他栅栏的图标都在「桌面」栅栏里。新装的 PecoFence 会把它<: Yes. Icons that are in no other fence are in the “Desktop” fence. A new PecoFence setup turns on “Arrange like the desktop” and “Place freely” for it, as a new Windows desktop is set up: no title or edges, an icon stays in the grid cell of the desktop you drag it to, also after a restart, and new icons stand down columns from the top-left corner of the screen. The first time “Place freely” is on, each icon takes the place it has on the Windows desktop. In a setup from before, turn it on yourself: right-click one of the icons and click “Place freely”. With it off, the icons keep their order as on a Windows desktop with “Auto arrange icons” on. “Arrange like the desktop” turns the whole arrangement off: “Desktop” is a normal fence again that you can move and resize. Both switches are also in “Settings” → “Fences” once you choose “Desktop”. If you would rather not see a “Desktop” fence, keep it arranged like the desktop: it has no edges and shows nothing while it holds no icons.
page.配置文件在哪？便携版呢？: Where is the configuration file? And with the portable edition?
page.打开「设置」→「布局与备份」，在「备份」下面就能看到配置文件的位置，点<b>「打: “Settings” → “Layout and backups” shows where the configuration file is, under “Backups”, and Open configuration folder opens it. It's usually in %APPDATA%\PecoFence; for the Microsoft Store edition it's in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\DayuanJiang.PecoFence_0bme5nfnaj27p\LocalCache\Roaming\PecoFence. When you start the portable edition with the --portable option, it uses the config folder next to the app instead.
page.怎么备份？换电脑时怎么办？: How do I back up, or move to a new PC?
page.到「设置」→「布局与备份」，点<b>「导出…」</b>，把设置、整理规则和栅栏布: Go to “Settings” → “Layout and backups” and select Export… to save your settings, sorting rules and fence layout to one file. Then select Import… on the new PC. The files on your desktop aren't included, so copy them over yourself. PecoFence also makes a backup every day; the last 7 are listed on the same page, and Restore brings one back. Restoring a backup replaces your settings and rules too.
page.怎么设置开机启动？: How do I make PecoFence start with Windows?
page.默认就会随 Windows 启动，开关在「设置」→「常规」→<b>「随 Wind: It starts with Windows by default. The switch is in “Settings” → “General” → Start with Windows. The portable edition started with --portable doesn't set this up by itself, so turn the switch on yourself. The Microsoft Store edition uses the same switch. If you turned PecoFence off on the Apps → Startup page of Windows Settings or in Task Manager, it can only be turned on again there, and the switch then opens that page.
page.速览的快捷键按了没反应？: Nothing happens when I press the Peek shortcut?
page.右键托盘图标，「速览所有栅栏」后面显示的就是现在能用的快捷键。你选的快捷键被系统: Right-click the tray icon: the shortcut shown next to “Peek at all fences” is the one that works right now. If Windows or another app already uses the shortcut you chose, PecoFence switches to a free one and tells you. If no shortcut is shown, Peek is turned off or every shortcut is taken, and you can still select the menu item itself. With “Press Ctrl twice” chosen, the menu says “Press Ctrl twice”, and the taps do nothing while a full-screen game or video is in front. The switch and the shortcut are in “Settings” → Peek and search. The Keyboard shortcut list shows the one you chose. When it is taken, the text under “Keyboard shortcut” says which one works instead. To change it, choose another one from the list, or choose Custom… and press the new keys.
page.搜索时为什么找不到电脑上别的文件？: Why doesn't the search find other files on my computer?
page.搜索框默认找的是栅栏里的图标。想找整台电脑上的文件，到「设置」→「速览与搜索」打: By default, the search box looks at the icons in your fences. To find files on the whole computer, turn on Peek search also finds files on the whole computer (Everything) in “Settings” → “Peek and search”. This uses Everything, a free file search tool, and the switch shows its state underneath. If it isn't installed, select Install Everything: PecoFence installs version 1.5 with winget and starts it, and Windows asks once for administrator rights. If it's installed but not running, select Start Everything. Finding Chinese names on the whole computer by pinyin needs version 1.5. With an older version, select Upgrade to 1.5.
page.脚本栅栏会运行什么？: What does a script fence run?
page.脚本栅栏运行的是你自己选的脚本文件，每次最多 10 秒，不弹出窗口，脚本启动的程: A script fence runs the script file you chose yourself, for at most 10 seconds each time and without a window, and the programs the script starts end with it. A script that says it keeps running runs until its fence is deleted, the “Tools” switch is turned off or PecoFence exits. A click on a row of the fence also does what the script wrote: it opens a web page or a file, runs a program the script names, or runs the script again. PecoFence itself never goes online for script fences. A configuration someone shares may contain script fences, so when an imported configuration has script fences, the “Tools” switch is turned off first and you get a notice. Once you've read the scripts and trust them, turn the switch back on in “Settings” → “Tools”. For how to write scripts, see “Write your own script fence”.
page.怎么知道有没有新版本？: How do I know a new version is out?
page.安装版和 ZIP 版每天自己检查一次 GitHub 上有没有新版本。有新版本时，: The installer and ZIP editions check GitHub for a new version once a day. When there is one, a card shows in the bottom-right corner of the screen, once per version, and the tray menu gets Update to … at the top; click it to update: the installer edition downloads the new setup and installs it, the ZIP edition opens the download page. To stop the automatic check, turn off Check for updates automatically in “Settings” → “About”; the Check for updates button there checks by hand at any time. The Microsoft Store edition is updated by the Store.
page.遇到问题怎么反馈？: How do I report a problem?
page.右键托盘图标，选<b>「发送反馈…」</b>，或者打开「设置」→「关于」，在下面: Right-click the tray icon and select Send feedback…, or open “Settings” → “About” and use the “Feedback” section further down. stage.鼠标在标签页上停留片刻就切换过去，不用点击: Rest the pointer on a tab for a moment to switch to it without clicking
stage.降低图标饱和度和不透明度，让桌面看起来更清爽: Reduce icon saturation and opacity for a quieter desktop
stage.和 Windows 桌面一样，在快捷方式图标的左下角显示小箭头: Shows the small arrow at the bottom left of shortcut icons, as on the Windows desktop
stage.拖动时吸附到其他栅栏、屏幕边缘和屏幕中线；按住 Alt 可暂时不吸附: Snap to other fences, the screen edges and the screen's center lines while dragging; hold Alt to move freely
stage.移动和调整大小时，栅栏之间以及与屏幕边缘保持的距离: The gap kept between fences and from screen edges when you move or resize them
stage.调整大小时按整行整列对齐: Resize in whole rows and columns
stage.宽度按整列、高度按整行；关闭后可自由调整大小，图标自动铺满: Width snaps to whole columns and height to whole rows. When off, fences can be any size and icons spread out to fill them

stage.便签、时钟和脚本放在栅栏里，和普通栅栏一样可以移动、吸附和收起。: Notes, clocks and scripts live in fences: you move, snap and roll them up like any other fence.
stage.关上后，桌面上的小工具都不显示，脚本也全部停下: When off, no tools show on the desktop and every script stops
stage.在栅栏里写几行字，单击就能编辑。行首写 [ ] 的一行会变成可以勾选的待办: Write a few lines in a fence and click to edit them. A line that starts with [ ] becomes a to-do you can tick
stage.显示时间、日期和星期。右键时钟可以打开「显示秒」: Shows the time, date and weekday. Right-click the clock to turn on Show seconds
stage.今天和明天的天气，每 30 分钟更新，数据来自 wttr.in。添加后右键它选「: Today’s and tomorrow’s weather, updated every 30 minutes, from wttr.in. After adding it, right-click it, choose Edit script and replace Tokyo with your city
stage.一个仓库最新的 issue 和 PR，点一行在浏览器里打开。添加后右键它选「编辑: A repository’s newest issues and pull requests. Click a row to open it in your browser. After adding it, right-click it, choose Edit script and put in the repository you follow
stage.一直运行，每 2 秒更新 CPU、内存和每个磁盘的剩余空间。点一行可以复制本机: Keeps running and updates CPU, memory and the free space on each drive every 2 seconds. Click a row to copy this PC’s IP address or open Task Manager
stage.运行你选的脚本（PowerShell、Python、批处理等），把它打印的文字显: Runs a script you choose (PowerShell, Python, batch files and more) and shows the text it prints in a fence. A script runs for up to 10 seconds (unless it is marked to keep running) and opens no window. PecoFence never goes online for scripts
stage.其中的 {0} 个图标会回到“{1}”栅栏，文件本身不受影响。: Icons in this fence: {0}. They'll go back to the “{1}” fence; the files themselves won't be affected.
stage.点「撤销」，或在栅栏上按 Ctrl+Z，就能把它找回来。: Click Undo, or press Ctrl+Z on a fence, to get it back.
stage.图标回到原来的栅栏: The icon is back in its fence
stage.栅栏和图标都回来了: The fence and its icons are back
stage.栅栏“{0}”现在只在“{1}”上显示，切换到那个虚拟桌面就能看到它。: The fence “{0}” now shows only on “{1}”. Switch to that virtual desktop to see it.
stage.标题前的小图标：只在这个桌面显示: The small icon: on this desktop only
stage.「游戏」栅栏不在这个桌面了: The Games fence is not on this desktop
